definitions.explanation: The circumstances of one's growth from childhood, including family environment, education, and experiences that shaped who one is today.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{生|お}い{立|た}ちを{聞|き}いた。
{複雑|ふくざつ}な{生|お}い{立|た}ちを{持|も}っている。
{作家|さっか}の{生|お}い{立|た}ちを{知|し}ると、{作品|さくひん}の{理解|りかい}が{深|ふか}まることがある。
examples.english: Knowing about an author's background can deepen your understanding of their works.

notes:
{生|お}い{立|た}ち refers to the story of one's childhood and how one grew up.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生|お}い{立|た}ちを{語|かた}る (tell about one's upbringing)
- {生|お}い{立|た}ちを{聞|き}く (hear about someone's background)
- {複雑|ふくざつ}な{生|お}い{立|た}ち (complicated background)
- {恵|めぐ}まれた{生|お}い{立|た}ち (privileged upbringing)

ETYMOLOGY: From {生|お}い{立|た}つ (to grow up), the noun form of this verb.
